title: Fix broken category/subcategory icons using local SVGs only (no external images)

requirements.text: Audit the frontend to find every category/subcategory icon reference used in the UI and ensure all icon sources are local SVG files under frontend/public/assets/generated (no external URLs and no internet fetching). Update any stale/broken icon paths so they point to existing local SVG filenames.

quotes: Replace all broken images with built-in SVG icons.
Do not fetch images from internet.
Every category and subcategory must have a simple icon.

acceptanceCriteria: No icon src (or CSS background-image) references an http/https URL anywhere in the app.
All category and subcategory icon references resolve to files under /assets/generated/*.svg.
All icon filenames referenced in code exist in frontend/public/assets/generated.

requirements.text: Ensure all category and subcategory icons render through the existing SafeIconImage component (or an equivalent centralized icon component) so broken/missing/empty icon sources always render the local fallback SVG icon instead of a broken image placeholder, while keeping the existing layout unchanged.

quotes: Replace all broken images with built-in SVG icons.

acceptanceCriteria: If an icon src is empty, whitespace, invalid, or the file fails to load, the UI renders /assets/generated/icon-fallback.dim_128x128.svg.
No broken-image placeholders appear on the Home page category grid or Local Skilled Workers subcategory grid.
No changes to spacing, grid columns, card sizes, or typography on pages where icons appear (layout remains unchanged).

requirements.text: Generate or add any missing local SVG icon assets required by the current category and Local Skilled Workers subcategory taxonomy, using a consistent simple icon style and the exact filenames referenced by the frontend.

quotes: Every category and subcategory must have a simple icon.

acceptanceCriteria: All required SVG icon files exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the exact filenames referenced by the code.
All icons are simple SVGs (no embedded external image links) and render correctly at small sizes (e.g., 64–96px) without clipping.
The fallback icon file /assets/generated/icon-fallback.dim_128x128.svg exists and is used automatically when needed.

constraints: Do not fetch icons/images from the internet at runtime.
Keep the existing UI layout unchanged (no changes to grids, spacing, sizing, or component structure beyond swapping/fixing icon sources and fallback behavior).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: No changes to category/subcategory taxonomy labels or translations.
No redesign or restyling beyond icon asset/path fixes and fallback behavior.

required: Simple one day cooking worker icon (icon-one-day-cooking-worker.dim_128x128.svg)

preferencesToAdd: Use local SVG icons only; never fetch icons/images from the internet.
